notes.title: [UPDATE 1.7] The Invincible - Cosmic Pierogi
notes.notes:
Tomorrow, space will welcome the second Polish astronaut!


Mission IGNIS starts at 2:22 pm CEST, when a Falcon 9 rocket with the crewed Dragon capsule will launch from the John F. Kennedy Space Center in Florida.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748592/e77a48a148651c0f70418b94606765ab28fae029.png"]

Among the four-person Ax-4 crew is Dr Sławosz Uznański-Wiśniewski, a Polish astronaut of the European Space Agency. He will become the second Pole in history to travel to space, and the first to spend time aboard the International Space Station (ISS).


As part of the IGNIS mission, the Polish astronaut will conduct 13 experiments developed by Polish companies and universities. The research will span a wide range of fields, including astronaut health, the human microbiome, new materials, and advanced technologies.


From Poland’s milk bar to the Milky Way!


To celebrate it, we have prepared a rover skin based on an internationally acclaimed Polish dish that Sławosz will bring into space: Cosmic Pierogis.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748592/afae3c81a73bf085b78ba98bdf4a8aa10bb17e09.png"]



We hope that you will enjoy its unique taste and bring its flavour together with you to each corner of Regis III.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748592/0b90dd539d3f1c89638a1fa9b9e2e1feafd71542.png"]



Every astroscientist deserves comfort food after they face mind-boggling phenomena that make them rethink everything they know about human species, science and the universe.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748592/976fb85fb65c09e3dcd33d14fd6fbb36a20e1258.png"]


- Starward Industries & 11 bit studios

notes.title: Voyager Update is out now!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748592/898b452a4115cece189c5e64d167b1b18ca22923.jpg

Astronaut,

Look at the foreign horizon. Stretching wide before you, inviting you to search through its every nook and cranny. Reddish sand gives way to the force of your feet walking briskly toward the unknown. You open the rover’s door, sit behind the wheel and start the engine. Somehow it feels as if a completely new perspective unfolds in front of your eyes. You can only imagine what mind boggling discoveries await you on Regis III…

The Invincible Voyager Update is here! We have enhanced the exploration of Regis III and improved a few elements of your astromission. Thank you, astronauts, for supporting us along this journey! We are awaiting your feedback regarding the improvements, so let us know what you think in the comments, Discussions or on our Discord.

[previewyoutube=Yt7OTT0iFXQ;full][/previewyoutube]

What's new in the Voyager Update:

Dynamic Camera Views during Rover ride
Experience the thrill of exploring Regis III from a new perspective... Now, with our latest update, you can switch your camera from First-Person (FPP) to Third-Person (TPP) during your Rover ride. It’s time to dive into a world of scientific wonder and look at astounding landscapes from a new angle.

Enhanced Walk & Sprint Speed in some locations
We have tweaked the speed in which Yasna travels through Regis III, as it was an adjustment you highly requested. Further improvements are limited due to the expanded dialogue system and the pacing problems that would occur if Yasna were to move faster. However, we still wanted to enhance your gameplay experience in this matter, so we gave Yasna a little boost wherever it was possible.

New Story slides to discover
The scope of mysteries awaiting to be discovered by you has expanded with additional slides scattered across Regis III. Unearth these hidden treasures to delve deeper into the rich lore and mysteries of the planet. Each discovery brings you closer to unraveling the mind-boggling phenomena of Regis III…

*Experimental Feature: Wider FOV in Accessibility Settings
We have heard loud and clear your desire to have a wider FOV option. Our team has been working on finding a way to do that without breaking the game almost from the release date. During this process, we have widened the FOV from 70 to 80 and then 90. We found out that further FOV iterations may cause some technical problems, i.e.:
 HUD interaction icons start to move around, which may cause problems with the navigation and controls
 proportions of environmental elements and NPCs are changing unnaturally
 one can see holes in the spacesuit

However, given that the wider FOV is one of the most requested features of The Invincible and that we really want to enhance your immersion on this otherworldly mission, we decided to release an experimental feature of wider FOV (100, 110, 120) for those of you who want to try it out.

You will be able to use it freely and see whether this partial solution works for you. In the near future we will try to minimize a part of the visual and gameplay issues coming from wider FOVs.

The only important thing to keep in mind is that wider FOV settings may result in higher performance demand - it works similarly to choosing a higher quality of graphics. Apart from that, we hope that this new feature will be to your liking!

You can access the experimental FOV by following two steps:
1. Toggle on experimental FOV option in the Accessibility Settings tab.
2. Go to the Graphics tab and change the FOV.


Additionally:
 Added in-game input to directly launch comics, allowing you also to dive into your unique play story with the possibility to enlarge exact frames.
 Changed flashbacks fade in/out color.
 Added an option in accessibility to turn off automatic interactions.
 Updated decal appearance to indicate the possibility to climb.
 Bug fixes for some camera movement and slides inspect mode.
 Minor animation and audio adjustments.
 Performance and UI issue fixes.
 Minor localization adjustments.


Take care!

notes.title: [HOTFIX 1.0.3] Spacecraft Repairs: ultrawide support, hardlocks & UI

Minimum requirements

notes.title: [HOTFIX 1.0.2] Spacecraft Repairs: PC requirements, DLSS & hardlocks
notes.notes:
Big thank you to every astronaut who has submitted bugs/feedback, and thank you all for taking part in The Invincible’s cosmic adventure!
Since the release we have been working hard to solve as many of the reported issues as possible. Here’s another part of spacecraft improvements.

Improvements

Save system

- Thank you for all your feedback about the game's save system. We have made a small improvement for now, but we plan to make more fundamental changes to this system in the near future as a part of a larger patch. 
Since this hotfix, a separate backup of your save is made before every new checkpoint. This will allow you to manually overwrite your chosen slot save in case you meet any hardlock or want to go back to the exact moment of your playthrough.

All your saves can be found in this folder:
C:\Users\\AppData\Local\TheInvincible\Saved\SaveGames

Minimal requirements

- More astronauts are now able to take part in the mission on Regis III as we have optimized the game for older graphics cards with 2GB or 3GB RAM. In Full HD on High and Epic settings, the game should work at around 25-30 FPS.
Due to this improvement, we are changing the minimal requirements for graphics to AMD R7 260x (2GB) or Nvidia GTX 760 (2GB).

DLSS

- Added presets for DLSS quality settings.

Other improvements

- Fixed various hardlocks and softlocks reported by players (old saves should also work properly in these cases):
- further fixes for a missing interaction of the passage between rocks in the City area,
- further fixes for Yasna getting stuck next to the window in one of the game's endings (the song's fault!),
- the possibility of getting blocked by an invisible wall on the 4th point looking for Gorsky and on the Convoy force field area,
- some cases with missing rover interactions,
- a possibility to avoid climbing interaction and blocking the game ending on the cliff,
- a double hint for a stuck vehicle in the Convoy area,
- a possibility to get stuck next to the landed probe in the Base area,
- general problems with hiding the equipment or map.
- Fixed several areas where players were able to get stuck between the landscape/props collisions (e.g. Base, City).
- Improved teleprobe behavior (crazy speeding and duplicating itself).
- Different minor quest/level design fixes.
- Default frame rate settings are now set based on the graphic quality preset.
- Fixed map layout reload from checkpoint.
- Fixed lighting parameters for Rohytra mesh during the battle scene.
- Some animation, environmental, and lighting fixes and polishing.
- Audio volume fixes for character voice-overs (e.g. inaudible Novik lines) and SFX for footsteps.

Issue reporting

From now on, when encountering any issues, you can also send us additional telemetric data from the game level, which will significantly speed up the debugging process. Just press CTRL+C during the game, open a Notepad, press CTRL+V and save the file, and include this as an attachment in the support form. Please, also attach your save files and a DxDiag report:

1. How to save a DxDiag report?

1. Click on Start.
2. Type "DxDiag" and launch DxDiag.
3. Click on "Save all information".
4. Save "Dxdiag.txt" file.

2. How to find your saves from the game?

If you downloaded the game to the C disk, you should find them in:
C:\Users\user_name\AppData\Local\TheInvincible\Saved\SaveGames

Astroscientist,

Your mission starts on November 6, 2023.

Prepare yourself for the upcoming mission on Regis III. A mere moment ago, you and your crew were engaged in a lively discussion about scientific phenomena. Now, in an inexplicable turn of events, you find yourself isolated, surrounded by the unsettling, uncharted surface of Regis III, in search for your lost crew.

Your task is clear: harness every atom-powered device at your disposal and summon every molecule of your unwavering determination. Find your missing crew and bring them back on deck. It's an unwritten rule of our species: no human shall be left behind, whether dead or alive.
